source_family_detail_review.summary: The src/main family contains the executable onboarding service, REST API boundary, outbound KYC integration, persistence orchestration, event publication and source contracts used by the final report.

business_view.purpose: Accept customer onboarding requests, verify identity, score risk, decide ACTIVE versus MANUAL_REVIEW, persist the customer and expose status lookup.

capabilities.name: Start customer onboarding
capabilities.description: The REST controller accepts onboarding requests and delegates the business decision to OnboardingService.

capabilities.name: Read onboarding status
capabilities.description: The REST controller exposes a status endpoint that returns the current customer status from the service.

user_or_system_flows.name: REST onboarding to persisted status and event
user_or_system_flows.description: A POST request enters the controller, is checked for duplicate e-mail, verified against KYC, risk-scored, assigned a status, saved and published as an onboarding event.

technical_view.architecture_role: Primary executable service family with REST contracts, application orchestration, outbound KYC call, repository persistence, event publication and OpenAPI/SOAP contract files.

entry_points.name: Status lookup
entry_points.description: HTTP entrypoint for current onboarding status.

exits_or_integrations.name: KYC verification
exits_or_integrations.description: The service posts first name, last name and birth date to the configured KYC provider URL shape.

exits_or_integrations.name: KYC status SOAP contract
exits_or_integrations.description: The WSDL defines GetKycStatus request/response messages and SOAP action metadata.

data_and_state.name: Customer status
data_and_state.description: Risk/KYC outcomes are mapped to ACTIVE or MANUAL_REVIEW.

data_and_state.name: Customer persistence
data_and_state.description: The decided Customer state is saved before the result is returned.

flows.title: Onboarding execution flow
flows.summary: The executable path runs from REST request through duplicate check, KYC call, risk score, status decision, persistence and event publication.

mermaid.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API as OnboardingController
  participant Service as OnboardingService
  participant KYC as KycClient
  participant DB as CustomerRepository
  participant Events as OnboardingEventPublisher
  Client->>API: POST /customers/onboard
  API->>Service: startOnboarding(request)
  Service->>DB: existsByEmail(email)
  Service->>KYC: verifyIdentity(...)
  Service->>Service: score and decide status
  Service->>DB: save(customer)
  Service->>Events: publishOnboardingStarted(...)
  API-->>Client: 202 response

steps.description: Service verifies duplicate e-mail, calls KYC and calculates risk.
Service chooses manual review when KYC fails or risk is above threshold; otherwise it activates the customer.

findings.title: Configuration-driven threshold is not wired into service logic
findings.description: Application configuration declares risk.threshold, while OnboardingService compares against a literal 70.
findings.recommendation: Inject the threshold from configuration and test both ACTIVE and MANUAL_REVIEW boundaries.

process_improvements.title: Add contract/runtime parity tests
process_improvements.description: The OpenAPI examples and controller/service behavior are aligned enough for generated tests, but no executable contract test is present in this source family.

recommendations.title: Extract onboarding decision policy
recommendations.benefit: Makes KYC/risk decision rules testable and configuration-driven.
recommendations.target_state: A small policy component receives KYC result, risk score and threshold and returns the target CustomerStatus.

open_questions.question: Should risk.threshold from application.yml be the authoritative production threshold?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The source has both a configured threshold and a literal service threshold.

analysis_coverage.summary: Focused review of src/main service code and source contracts used by the final demo report.

Main onboarding orchestration and decision logic.
Configuration threshold used in readiness and refactoring findings.
